notes:
v2.5.0 brings a new bank reconciliation screen that works like Xero's, plus copying jobs and two more bank CSV formats.

New in v2.5.0:

Bank reconciliation, rebuilt. Bank Rec now shows one card for each line on your bank statement. On the left is the statement line; on the right, either a suggested match to something already in Dogbox (an invoice payment, a bill payment, POS banking, a pay run) or a short form to record it (who, account, GST, description, or pay an open invoice or bill). Check it and click OK. Matching means money you've already recorded is no longer entered twice and rejected as a duplicate. A deposit that banks several receipts can be matched to all of them at once.

Bank rules fill in the form for you. Tick "Remember" on a card to save a new rule, and click Apply rules to record every line a rule covers in one go. Lines that might match something already in Dogbox are left for you to check.

Split a statement line across several accounts right on its card, or record a Transfer between your own bank, card and loan accounts. The other account's statement line then matches it.

Reconcile… takes the date and closing balance from your bank statement, checks that everything up to that date adds up, and marks it reconciled in one step, with the reconciliation report one click away. If it's out by a small amount you're sure about, such as a bank fee, you can record the difference as an adjustment.

The top of the screen shows your statement balance, the balance in Dogbox and the date you're reconciled to. Clear-cut matches can be accepted with one click. An Account transactions tab lists everything on the account with its status; Remove & redo there undoes a line you've OK'd but not yet reconciled. The previous screen is still there under Classic view.

The Bank Reconciliation guide (in-app Help and PDF) is rewritten for the new screen, and the Jobs guide covers copying a job.

Copy a job: the new ⧉ Copy button on a job makes a new job from it, for a repeat job or the same job for another client. You choose the name and client, and whether to bring its tasks, materials and to-dos. The copy starts as a Lead with no dates; money and history stay with the original.

Bank CSV import: new built-in formats for St.George / BankSA / Bank of Melbourne and for Regional Australia Bank.

Updates are now available to everyone. A Pro subscription's end date no longer stops updates; when a subscription ends, Pro features switch off (as when a trial ends) until it's renewed, and a renewal is picked up automatically.

Bug fixes in v2.5.0:

Bank rec rules: the account list in the New/Edit Rule form was always empty, so rules couldn't record anything. Closing or saving the rules dialog could also close the wrong window. Both are fixed, and you can double-click a rule to edit it.

Bank CSV import: files with separate Debit and Credit columns that write debits as negative numbers (e.g. -52.40) are now read correctly.

Behind the scenes:

Dogbox keeps its licence, error log, settings and app window profile in your own user folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Dogbox on Windows) instead of the install folder. Existing ones move across automatically the first time you start 2.5.0, including your saved bank CSV presets and theme. Company files aren't affected. This is groundwork for a Microsoft Store version of Dogbox.
